rect.title: Retired: mixed blue branches and missing intended upper ink; audit readings retained, temporal qualification removed
magenta_startup: baseline departure before sustained cluster; no pump-on claim
blue_terminal_candidate: branch continues into near-baseline tail x597..620; not authenticated pump-off
blue_tail: continuation following visible terminal fall; identity near baseline unresolved
purple_crossing: same-colour mergers; bundle includes alternatives, no trajectory rank join
purple_occludes_blue: other-colour occlusion; finite bridge rule conditional
blue_dash_gap: dashed context; no hidden-curve enclosure or gap bridge
lower_magenta_patterns: lower dashed/dotted support kept; no whole-condition completeness inferred
lower_purple_patterns: lower patterned support retained with explicit190/210/250 alternatives where unassigned

svg.text: Smrke, Eiermann & Yeretzian (2024), Supplementary Fig S1. CC BY 4.0. DOI:10.1038/s41598-024-55831-x.
Green: qualified regions/ticks. Red: excluded legend, unbridged gap and retired blue region. Orange: source diagnostics. Graphical support only.
